content.what_it_is: MATLAB preprocessing script that loads a three-column spectral dataset, integrates its wind-wave density, aggregates fixed blocks of frequency bins, derives resolved component amplitudes, compares raw/filtered/IG spectra in plots, writes four intermediate SPC files for later IG generation, and writes a FUNWAVE wind-wave-only spectrum (lines 1-112).

equations.ref: component Hmo for downstream IG script

io.name: FUNWAVE spectrum headers and coordinate arrays

unresolved: The final regular aggregation block begins at ii=1591 and consumes E(1591:1620) under lines 40-44, but the residual block starts at trun+sk=1631 at line 46. E(1621:1630) is omitted from both EE blocks, so E_t at line 50 is not energy-conservative relative to E_total at line 31.

Hard-coded slices require at least 100 rows and three columns at lines 24-25, at least 1620 integrated bins for the loop at lines 40-44, f(1646) at line 45, and E(1631:end) at line 46. No size check precedes these accesses, so shorter input_data_case1.txt files fail out of range.

depth and peak_freq are hard-coded at lines 18-19 rather than derived from input_data_case1.txt, and the output angle is likewise hard-coded to zero at lines 83 and 101; the generated SPC/FUNWAVE files cannot preserve differing case metadata present outside this script.

df and dff use only the first spacing at lines 35 and 47, while E itself uses every local spacing at line 28. The plotted densities at lines 63 and 66 therefore assume equal spacing without checking it, even though the energy integration supports nonuniform f.
The third plotted series E_IG_data is added at line 67, but the legend at line 72 supplies only two labels, leaving the displayed series-to-label mapping incomplete.
